limits: Database fixtures do not certify Shared/Commerce schema semantics, RFC8785 implementation or hash-content equality, service/UI/model behaviour.
READ COMMITTED guarded writes, or SERIALIZABLE with bounded whole-transaction retries; REPEATABLE READ fails closed.
298 counts include positive controls; this is not a claim of 298 independent invariants.

selectedCapabilityKeys byte-bound rejection is not claimed independently: valid keys are ASCII, <=128 characters, at most 32; the prior oversized invalid-Unicode fixture was removed because membership would reject it first.
